Review of select_lots_fefo (request_changes): The eligibility check contradicts the design review decision in the handover notes. The notes state: 'a lot already counts as expired ON its expiry_day: with min_shelf_days=0 a lot whose expiry_day == today is not eligible. Expired therefore means expiry_day <= today.' Your code checks `remaining_shelf >= min_shelf_days`, which allows expiry_day==today when min_shelf_days=0 (0>=0 is True). The condition should be `remaining_shelf > min_shelf_days` (strictly greater) to exclude lots expiring today when min_shelf_days=0. Please fix this and re-request review.
